title: Contingency Placement Agreements — Signature, Effective Date and Lapse of an Issued Agreement
content:
**Signature.** An agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements binds only on the client's own signature by an authorized signer; Ridgeline never activates an agreement on a verbal yes.

**Signature window.** An agreement is signed only when the handling date is no later than the last day of the signature window counted from its issued date. The signature window is the tier's signature window in calendar days, the day after the issued date being day one and the last day included. The issued date is read from the agreement record.

**Effective date and initial term.** The effective date is the later of the planned effective date and the signing date, and the initial term of the tier's initial term in months runs from the effective date.

**Lapse.** An agreement still unsigned after the window lapses and closes, its closing date being the first day after the signature window; the client is issued a new agreement if it still wants to place accounts.

## Condition – judgement – result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Signed by the client's authorized signer, handling date on or before the last day of the window | within the window | the agreement becomes active |
| Only a verbal yes | no signature | not activated |
| Handling date after the last day of the window, still unsigned | window lapsed | the agreement closes; a new agreement is issued if the client still wants to place accounts |

## Hypothetical cases

- An agreement issued under a tier with a 30-day signature window: day one is the day after issue, and the last day of the window is the 30th day after issue. A signature on the 30th day is within the window; on the 31st day it is not, and the agreement has lapsed, closing on that 31st day.
- An agreement with a planned effective date of the 1st of a month, signed on the 6th: the effective date is the 6th, the later of the two. Signed on the 25th of the previous month, its effective date is the planned 1st.
